title: Low-Calorie Korean Noodles Sujebi
description: A traditional Korean dish from the Gangwon region, featuring unsweetened cocoa and a unique tagine-cook method, this low-calorie sujebi is a comforting and savory delight. It has a salty and glassy-jelly texture that is sure to please.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the buckwheat noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the unsweetened cocoa powder, tagine spice blend, low-sodium soy sauce, and sesame oil.
In a large skillet, heat the cocoa mixture over medium heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the cocoa mixture.
Stir in the chopped green onions, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Serve the sujebi hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
Tagine-cook the sujebi by covering the skillet with a lid and cooking for an additional 5 minutes, allowing the noodles to absorb the flavors.
